title: Logspace-uniform circuit family
statement: A family of Boolean circuits is logspace-uniform if there is an implicitly logspace-computable function from bit strings to bit strings that, on the string of $n$ true bits, outputs the encoding of the circuit in the family for inputs of length $n$, for every natural number $n$.
